description: This file defines the TreeGrain class, which implements a hierarchical grain structure for a distributed system, including initialization of child grains and a Ping method for asynchronous communication.

classes.name: TreeGrain
classes.description: A class representing a hierarchical grain structure with child grains, supporting asynchronous ping operations.

methods.name: TreeGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grain, determines its level, and creates child grains accordingly.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Asynchronous method that pings all child grains and waits for their responses.
